membership_invite_contact_check.name: membership_invite_contact_check
membership_invite_contact_check.value: "app"."membership"."status" <> 'invited' OR "app"."membership"."invite_email" IS NOT NULL OR "app"."membership"."invite_phone_e164" IS NOT NULL

support_session_end_reason_check.name: support_session_end_reason_check
support_session_end_reason_check.value: ("app"."support_session"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("app"."support_session"."end_reason" IS NULL) AND ("app"."support_session"."end_reason" IS NULL OR "app"."support_session"."end_reason" IN ('ended', 'expired'))

legal_policy_approval_check.name: legal_policy_approval_check
legal_policy_approval_check.value: "app"."legal_policy"."status" = 'draft' OR ("app"."legal_policy"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."legal_policy"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."legal_policy"."approval_reference")) > 0)
